#### Q26: Implement a comprehensive logging system demonstrating method hiding vs method overriding
**Companies**: Google, Microsoft, Amazon  
**Difficulty**: Medium → Hard (with comprehensive implementation)  
**Category**: Inheritance & Polymorphism  
**Interview Frequency**: 85% (Core OOP concept tested frequently)

**Question**: Design and implement a logging system that demonstrates the difference between method hiding (static methods) and method overriding (instance methods). Show how compile-time vs runtime binding affects behavior in a real-world scenario.

**Conceptual Answer**:
- **Method Hiding**: Occurs with static methods - resolved at compile-time based on reference type
- **Method Overriding**: Occurs with instance methods - resolved at runtime based on actual object type
- **Key Difference**: Hiding is compile-time binding, overriding is runtime binding (polymorphism)

**Real-World Implementation Challenge**: Create a logging framework that handles different log levels and destinations, demonstrating both static utility methods (hiding) and instance-based formatters (overriding).

### Solution Approach 1: Basic Implementation (Demonstrates the Problem)

**Java Implementation**:
```java
/**
 * Basic logging without proper understanding of hiding vs overriding
 * Problems: Confusion between static and instance method behavior
 */
public class BasicLogger {
    
    // Static method - will be HIDDEN, not overridden
    public static void logMessage(String message) {
        System.out.println("BasicLogger: " + message);
    }
    
    // Instance method - will be OVERRIDDEN
    public void formatMessage(String message) {
        System.out.println("Basic format: " + message);
    }
}

public class AdvancedLogger extends BasicLogger {
    
    // This HIDES the parent static method (compile-time binding)
    public static void logMessage(String message) {
        System.out.println("AdvancedLogger: " + message);
    }
    
    // This OVERRIDES the parent instance method (runtime binding)
    @Override
    public void formatMessage(String message) {
        System.out.println("Advanced format: [" + message + "]");
    }
}

// Demonstration of the confusion
public class ConfusingExample {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        BasicLogger basicRef = new AdvancedLogger();
        
        // Static method call - uses REFERENCE type (BasicLogger)
        basicRef.logMessage("Test");  // Output: "BasicLogger: Test"
        
        // Instance method call - uses ACTUAL object type (AdvancedLogger)
        basicRef.formatMessage("Test"); // Output: "Advanced format: [Test]"
        
        // This behavior confuses many developers!
    }
}
```

**Problems with Basic Approach**:
- Mixing static and instance methods creates confusion
- No clear separation of concerns
- Hard to understand binding behavior
- Not suitable for production logging systems

### Solution Approach 2: Optimal Implementation (Production-Ready)

**Java Implementation**:
```java
/**
 * COMPREHENSIVE LOGGING SYSTEM: Demonstrates method hiding vs overriding properly
 * Features: Multiple log levels, different destinations, proper OOP design
 */

// Enum for log levels
public enum LogLevel {
    DEBUG(0, "DEBUG"), 
    INFO(1, "INFO"), 
    WARN(2, "WARN"), 
    ERROR(3, "ERROR");
    
    private final int priority;
    private final String name;
    
    LogLevel(int priority, String name) {
        this.priority = priority;
        this.name = name;
    }
    
    public int getPriority() { return priority; }
    public String getName() { return name; }
    
    public boolean shouldLog(LogLevel threshold) {
        return this.priority >= threshold.priority;
    }
}

/**
 * STATIC UTILITY CLASS: Demonstrates method hiding
 * These methods are resolved at compile-time based on reference type
 */
public class LoggerUtils {
    private static LogLevel currentLevel = LogLevel.INFO;
    
    // Static method - will be HIDDEN by subclasses
    public static void setLogLevel(LogLevel level) {
        currentLevel = level;
        System.out.println("LoggerUtils: Log level set to " + level.getName());
    }
    
    // Static method - compile-time binding
    public static boolean shouldLog(LogLevel level) {
        return level.shouldLog(currentLevel);
    }
    
    // Static method - utility function
    public static String getCurrentTimestamp() {
        return java.time.LocalDateTime.now().toString();
    }
    
    // Static method - formatting utility
    public static String formatLogEntry(LogLevel level, String message) {
        return String.format("[%s] %s: %s", 
            getCurrentTimestamp(), level.getName(), message);
    }
}

/**
 * ENHANCED STATIC UTILITIES: Demonstrates method hiding
 */
public class EnhancedLoggerUtils extends LoggerUtils {
    
    // This HIDES the parent static method (compile-time binding)
    public static void setLogLevel(LogLevel level) {
        System.out.println("EnhancedLoggerUtils: Setting enhanced log level to " + level.getName());
        // Call parent method using class name (not super - that's for instance methods)
        LoggerUtils.setLogLevel(level);
        
        // Additional enhanced functionality
        if (level == LogLevel.DEBUG) {
            System.out.println("EnhancedLoggerUtils: Debug mode enabled - performance may be affected");
        }
    }
    
    // Additional static method specific to enhanced version
    public static String formatLogEntryWithColor(LogLevel level, String message) {
        String colorCode = getColorCode(level);
        return colorCode + formatLogEntry(level, message) + "\u001B[0m"; // Reset color
    }
    
    private static String getColorCode(LogLevel level) {
        switch (level) {
            case DEBUG: return "\u001B[36m"; // Cyan
            case INFO:  return "\u001B[32m"; // Green
            case WARN:  return "\u001B[33m"; // Yellow
            case ERROR: return "\u001B[31m"; // Red
            default:    return "\u001B[0m";  // Reset
        }
    }
}

/**
 * ABSTRACT LOG FORMATTER: Base class for instance method overriding
 * These methods are resolved at runtime based on actual object type
 */
public abstract class LogFormatter {
    protected String applicationName;
    protected boolean includeThreadInfo;
    
    public LogFormatter(String applicationName, boolean includeThreadInfo) {
        this.applicationName = applicationName;
        this.includeThreadInfo = includeThreadInfo;
    }
    
    // Instance method - will be OVERRIDDEN (runtime binding)
    public abstract String formatMessage(LogLevel level, String message);
    
    // Instance method - can be overridden but has default implementation
    public String formatException(LogLevel level, String message, Throwable throwable) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append(formatMessage(level, message));
        sb.append("\nException: ").append(throwable.getClass().getSimpleName());
        sb.append(": ").append(throwable.getMessage());
        
        // Add stack trace for ERROR level
        if (level == LogLevel.ERROR) {
            sb.append("\nStack trace:\n");
            for (StackTraceElement element : throwable.getStackTrace()) {
                sb.append("  at ").append(element.toString()).append("\n");
            }
        }
        
        return sb.toString();
    }
    
    // Protected helper method for subclasses
    protected String getThreadInfo() {
        if (!includeThreadInfo) return "";
        Thread currentThread = Thread.currentThread();
        return String.format(" [Thread: %s-%d]", 
            currentThread.getName(), currentThread.getId());
    }
    
    // Final method - cannot be overridden
    public final String getApplicationName() {
        return applicationName;
    }
}

/**
 * SIMPLE LOG FORMATTER: Demonstrates method overriding
 */
public class SimpleLogFormatter extends LogFormatter {
    
    public SimpleLogFormatter(String applicationName) {
        super(applicationName, false);
    }
    
    // This OVERRIDES the parent abstract method (runtime binding)
    @Override
    public String formatMessage(LogLevel level, String message) {
        return String.format("[%s] %s - %s: %s",
            LoggerUtils.getCurrentTimestamp(),
            applicationName,
            level.getName(),
            message
        );
    }
}

/**
 * DETAILED LOG FORMATTER: Demonstrates method overriding with enhanced functionality
 */
public class DetailedLogFormatter extends LogFormatter {
    private final String hostname;
    private final String version;
    
    public DetailedLogFormatter(String applicationName, String hostname, String version) {
        super(applicationName, true); // Enable thread info
        this.hostname = hostname;
        this.version = version;
    }
    
    // This OVERRIDES the parent abstract method (runtime binding)
    @Override
    public String formatMessage(LogLevel level, String message) {
        return String.format("[%s] %s v%s@%s%s - %s: %s",
            LoggerUtils.getCurrentTimestamp(),
            applicationName,
            version,
            hostname,
            getThreadInfo(),
            level.getName(),
            message
        );
    }
    
    // This OVERRIDES the parent method with enhanced functionality
    @Override
    public String formatException(LogLevel level, String message, Throwable throwable) {
        String baseFormat = super.formatException(level, message, throwable);
        
        // Add additional context for detailed formatter
        StringBuilder enhanced = new StringBuilder(baseFormat);
        enhanced.append("\nSystem Info:");
        enhanced.append("\n  Hostname: ").append(hostname);
        enhanced.append("\n  Application: ").append(applicationName).append(" v").append(version);
        enhanced.append("\n  Java Version: ").append(System.getProperty("java.version"));
        enhanced.append("\n  Available Memory: ").append(Runtime.getRuntime().freeMemory() / 1024 / 1024).append(" MB");
        
        return enhanced.toString();
    }
}

/**
 * JSON LOG FORMATTER: Another override example for structured logging
 */
public class JsonLogFormatter extends LogFormatter {
    
    public JsonLogFormatter(String applicationName) {
        super(applicationName, true);
    }
    
    // This OVERRIDES the parent abstract method (runtime binding)
    @Override
    public String formatMessage(LogLevel level, String message) {
        return String.format(
            "{\"timestamp\":\"%s\",\"application\":\"%s\",\"level\":\"%s\",\"thread\":\"%s\",\"message\":\"%s\"}",
            LoggerUtils.getCurrentTimestamp(),
            applicationName,
            level.getName(),
            Thread.currentThread().getName(),
            escapeJson(message)
        );
    }
    
    private String escapeJson(String input) {
        return input.replace("\"", "\\\"")
                   .replace("\n", "\\n")
                   .replace("\r", "\\r")
                   .replace("\t", "\\t");
    }
    
    @Override
    public String formatException(LogLevel level, String message, Throwable throwable) {
        return String.format(
            "{\"timestamp\":\"%s\",\"application\":\"%s\",\"level\":\"%s\",\"thread\":\"%s\",\"message\":\"%s\",\"exception\":\"%s\",\"stackTrace\":\"%s\"}",
            LoggerUtils.getCurrentTimestamp(),
            applicationName,
            level.getName(),
            Thread.currentThread().getName(),
            escapeJson(message),
            throwable.getClass().getSimpleName(),
            escapeJson(throwable.getMessage())
        );
    }
}

/**
 * COMPREHENSIVE LOGGER: Combines static utilities and instance formatters
 */
public class ComprehensiveLogger {
    private final LogFormatter formatter;
    private final LogLevel threshold;
    private final String loggerName;
    
    public ComprehensiveLogger(String loggerName, LogFormatter formatter, LogLevel threshold) {
        this.loggerName = loggerName;
        this.formatter = formatter;
        this.threshold = threshold;
    }
    
    // Instance methods that delegate to formatter (demonstrates overriding)
    public void debug(String message) {
        log(LogLevel.DEBUG, message);
    }
    
    public void info(String message) {
        log(LogLevel.INFO, message);
    }
    
    public void warn(String message) {
        log(LogLevel.WARN, message);
    }
    
    public void error(String message) {
        log(LogLevel.ERROR, message);
    }
    
    public void error(String message, Throwable throwable) {
        if (LoggerUtils.shouldLog(LogLevel.ERROR) && LogLevel.ERROR.shouldLog(threshold)) {
            String formattedMessage = formatter.formatException(LogLevel.ERROR, message, throwable);
            System.err.println(formattedMessage);
        }
    }
    
    private void log(LogLevel level, String message) {
        // Uses static method (compile-time binding)
        if (LoggerUtils.shouldLog(level) && level.shouldLog(threshold)) {
            // Uses instance method (runtime binding - polymorphism)
            String formattedMessage = formatter.formatMessage(level, message);
            
            if (level == LogLevel.ERROR) {
                System.err.println(formattedMessage);
            } else {
                System.out.println(formattedMessage);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Getters
    public String getLoggerName() { return loggerName; }
    public LogLevel getThreshold() { return threshold; }
    public LogFormatter getFormatter() { return formatter; }
}

/**
 * DEMONSTRATION CLASS: Shows method hiding vs overriding in action
 */
public class LoggingSystemDemo {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        System.out.println("=== DEMONSTRATING METHOD HIDING (Static Methods) ===");
        
        // Method hiding demonstration
        LoggerUtils basicUtils = new EnhancedLoggerUtils(); // Reference type: LoggerUtils
        
        // Static method call - resolved at COMPILE TIME based on REFERENCE type
        basicUtils.setLogLevel(LogLevel.DEBUG); // Calls LoggerUtils.setLogLevel (HIDING)
        
        // Direct class call - shows the difference
        EnhancedLoggerUtils.setLogLevel(LogLevel.DEBUG); // Calls EnhancedLoggerUtils.setLogLevel
        
        System.out.println("\n=== DEMONSTRATING METHOD OVERRIDING (Instance Methods) ===");
        
        // Method overriding demonstration
        LogFormatter[] formatters = {
            new SimpleLogFormatter("MyApp"),
            new DetailedLogFormatter("MyApp", "server-01", "1.0.0"),
            new JsonLogFormatter("MyApp")
        };
        
        // Runtime polymorphism - method resolved based on ACTUAL object type
        for (LogFormatter formatter : formatters) {
            System.out.println("\nFormatter: " + formatter.getClass().getSimpleName());
            
            // Same method call, different behavior based on actual object type (OVERRIDING)
            String formatted = formatter.formatMessage(LogLevel.INFO, "Application started successfully");
            System.out.println(formatted);
        }
        
        System.out.println("\n=== COMPREHENSIVE LOGGING SYSTEM IN ACTION ===");
        
        // Create loggers with different formatters
        ComprehensiveLogger simpleLogger = new ComprehensiveLogger(
            "SimpleLogger", 
            new SimpleLogFormatter("WebApp"), 
            LogLevel.INFO
        );
        
        ComprehensiveLogger detailedLogger = new ComprehensiveLogger(
            "DetailedLogger", 
            new DetailedLogFormatter("WebApp", "prod-server-01", "2.1.0"), 
            LogLevel.DEBUG
        );
        
        ComprehensiveLogger jsonLogger = new ComprehensiveLogger(
            "JsonLogger", 
            new JsonLogFormatter("WebApp"), 
            LogLevel.WARN
        );
        
        // Test logging with different formatters (runtime polymorphism)
        ComprehensiveLogger[] loggers = {simpleLogger, detailedLogger, jsonLogger};
        
        for (ComprehensiveLogger logger : loggers) {
            System.out.println("\n--- " + logger.getLoggerName() + " ---");
            logger.debug("Debug message - may not appear based on threshold");
            logger.info("Application initialized");
            logger.warn("Low memory warning");
            logger.error("Database connection failed", new RuntimeException("Connection timeout"));
        }
        
        System.out.println("\n=== KEY DIFFERENCES SUMMARY ===");
        System.out.println("1. METHOD HIDING (Static methods):");
        System.out.println("   - Resolved at COMPILE TIME");
        System.out.println("   - Based on REFERENCE type");
        System.out.println("   - No polymorphism");
        System.out.println("   - Use class name to call specific version");
        
        System.out.println("\n2. METHOD OVERRIDING (Instance methods):");
        System.out.println("   - Resolved at RUNTIME");
        System.out.println("   - Based on ACTUAL object type");
        System.out.println("   - Enables polymorphism");
        System.out.println("   - Same interface, different behavior");
    }
}
```

**Python Implementation** (Showing Similar Concepts):
```python
"""
Python demonstration of method hiding vs overriding concepts
Note: Python doesn't have true method hiding like Java, but we can demonstrate similar concepts
"""

class LoggerUtils:
    """Static-like methods using @staticmethod and @classmethod"""
    
    current_level = "INFO"
    
    @classmethod
    def set_log_level(cls, level):
        """Class method - can be 'hidden' by subclasses"""
        cls.current_level = level
        print(f"LoggerUtils: Log level set to {level}")
    
    @staticmethod
    def format_message(level, message):
        """Static method - can be redefined in subclasses"""
        import datetime
        timestamp = datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()
        return f"[{timestamp}] {level}: {message}"

class EnhancedLoggerUtils(LoggerUtils):
    """Subclass that 'hides' parent class methods"""
    
    @classmethod
    def set_log_level(cls, level):
        """This 'hides' the parent class method"""
        print(f"EnhancedLoggerUtils: Setting enhanced log level to {level}")
        super().set_log_level(level)  # Call parent method
        
        if level == "DEBUG":
            print("EnhancedLoggerUtils: Debug mode enabled")
    
    @staticmethod
    def format_message(level, message):
        """This 'hides' the parent static method"""
        base_message = LoggerUtils.format_message(level, message)
        return f"ENHANCED: {base_message}"

class LogFormatter:
    """Base class for method overriding demonstration"""
    
    def __init__(self, app_name):
        self.app_name = app_name
    
    def format_message(self, level, message):
        """Instance method - will be overridden"""
        raise NotImplementedError("Subclasses must implement format_message")

class SimpleFormatter(LogFormatter):
    """Simple formatter - overrides parent method"""
    
    def format_message(self, level, message):
        """Override parent method"""
        import datetime
        timestamp = datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()
        return f"[{timestamp}] {self.app_name} - {level}: {message}"

class DetailedFormatter(LogFormatter):
    """Detailed formatter - overrides parent method"""
    
    def __init__(self, app_name, hostname, version):
        super().__init__(app_name)
        self.hostname = hostname
        self.version = version
    
    def format_message(self, level, message):
        """Override parent method with enhanced functionality"""
        import datetime, threading
        timestamp = datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()
        thread_name = threading.current_thread().name
        return f"[{timestamp}] {self.app_name} v{self.version}@{self.hostname} [{thread_name}] - {level}: {message}"

# Demonstration
def demonstrate_python_concepts():
    print("=== PYTHON METHOD 'HIDING' DEMONSTRATION ===")
    
    # Class method behavior
    LoggerUtils.set_log_level("DEBUG")
    EnhancedLoggerUtils.set_log_level("DEBUG")
    
    print("\n=== PYTHON METHOD OVERRIDING DEMONSTRATION ===")
    
    # Polymorphism with instance methods
    formatters = [
        SimpleFormatter("MyApp"),
        DetailedFormatter("MyApp", "server-01", "1.0.0")
    ]
    
    for formatter in formatters:
        print(f"\nFormatter: {formatter.__class__.__name__}")
        formatted = formatter.format_message("INFO", "Application started")
        print(formatted)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    demonstrate_python_concepts()
```

**JavaScript Implementation** (ES6+ Classes):

```javascript
/**

 * Note: JavaScript has different semantics but similar concepts

    static setLogLevel(level) {
        console.log(`EnhancedLoggerUtils: Setting enhanced log level to ${level}`);
        super.setLogLevel(level); // Call parent method
        
        if (level === 'DEBUG') {
            console.log('EnhancedLoggerUtils: Debug mode enabled');
        }
    }
    
    static formatMessage(level, message) {
        const baseMessage = super.formatMessage(level, message);
        return `ENHANCED: ${baseMessage}`;
    }
}

class LogFormatter {
    constructor(appName) {
        this.appName = appName;
    }
    
    // Instance method - will be overridden
    formatMessage(level, message) {
        throw new Error('Subclasses must implement formatMessage');
    }
}

class SimpleFormatter extends LogFormatter {
    // Override parent method
    formatMessage(level, message) {
        const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
        return `[${timestamp}] ${this.appName} - ${level}: ${message}`;
    }
}

class DetailedFormatter extends LogFormatter {
    constructor(appName, hostname, version) {
        super(appName);
        this.hostname = hostname;
        this.version = version;
    }
    
    // Override parent method with enhanced functionality
    formatMessage(level, message) {
        const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
        return `[${timestamp}] ${this.appName} v${this.version}@${this.hostname} - ${level}: ${message}`;
    }
}

// Demonstration
function demonstrateJavaScriptConcepts() {
    console.log('=== JAVASCRIPT METHOD "HIDING" DEMONSTRATION ===');
    
    // Static method behavior
    LoggerUtils.setLogLevel('DEBUG');
    EnhancedLoggerUtils.setLogLevel('DEBUG');
    
    console.log('\n=== JAVASCRIPT METHOD OVERRIDING DEMONSTRATION ===');
    
    // Polymorphism with instance methods
    const formatters = [
        new SimpleFormatter('MyApp'),
        new DetailedFormatter('MyApp', 'server-01', '1.0.0')
    ];
    
    formatters.forEach(formatter => {
        console.log(`\nFormatter: ${formatter.constructor.name}`);
        const formatted = formatter.formatMessage('INFO', 'Application started');
        console.log(formatted);
    });
}

demonstrateJavaScriptConcepts();
```

**Key Differences Explained**:

| Aspect | Method Hiding (Static) | Method Overriding (Instance) |
|--------|----------------------|----------------------------|
| **Binding Time** | Compile-time | Runtime |
| **Resolution Based On** | Reference type | Actual object type |
| **Polymorphism** | No | Yes |
| **Keyword** | `static` | `@Override` (Java) |
| **Inheritance** | Hidden, not inherited | Inherited and overridden |
| **Call Mechanism** | Class name or reference | Object reference |

**Real-World Applications**:
- **Google**: Logging frameworks in large-scale systems
- **Microsoft**: .NET logging infrastructure
- **Amazon**: CloudWatch logging with different formatters
- **Meta**: Distributed logging across microservices

**Follow-up Questions**:
- "How would you implement a logging system that supports both synchronous and asynchronous logging?"
- "What happens if you try to override a static method?"
- "How does method hiding affect unit testing?"
- "Can you explain the performance implications of method hiding vs overriding?"

**Complexity Analysis**:
- **Time Complexity**: O(1) for method calls in both cases
- **Space Complexity**: O(1) for method resolution
- **Compile-time Impact**: Method hiding resolved during compilation, overriding requires virtual method table

**Best Practices**:
1. Use static methods for utilities that don't need polymorphism
2. Use instance methods when you need runtime polymorphism
3. Avoid mixing static and instance methods in inheritance hierarchies
4. Document when you're intentionally hiding a static method
5. Use `@Override` annotation to catch overriding mistakes

#### Q27: Design a comprehensive access control system demonstrating private method behavior and encapsulation
**Companies**: Amazon, Apple, Google  
**Difficulty**: Medium → Hard (with comprehensive implementation)  
**Category**: Encapsulation & Access Control  
**Interview Frequency**: 80% (Fundamental encapsulation concept)

**Question**: Can you override a private method? Design and implement a comprehensive access control system that demonstrates private method behavior, method visibility, and proper encapsulation patterns in a real-world scenario.

**Conceptual Answer**:
- **Private methods cannot be overridden** because they are not inherited
- **Private methods are not visible** to subclasses
- **Creating a method with the same name** in a subclass creates a new method, not an override
- **Encapsulation principle**: Private methods hide implementation details

**Real-World Implementation Challenge**: Design a secure banking system that demonstrates proper access control, method visibility, and encapsulation patterns for handling sensitive financial operations.

### Solution Approach 1: Basic Implementation (Shows the Problem)

**Java Implementation**:
```java
/**
 * Basic banking system without proper access control
 * Problems: Poor encapsulation, security vulnerabilities, confusion about private methods
 */
public class BasicBankAccount {
    public double balance; // BAD: Public field
    
    // Private method - cannot be overridden
    private void validateTransaction(double amount) {
        if (amount <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Amount must be positive");
        }
    }
    
    // Public method that uses private method
    public void deposit(double amount) {
        validateTransaction(amount); // Calls private method
        balance += amount;
        System.out.println("BasicBankAccount: Deposited $" + amount);
    }
}

public class PremiumBankAccount extends BasicBankAccount {
    
    // This is NOT overriding - it's a completely new method!
    // The parent's private method is not inherited or visible
    private void validateTransaction(double amount) {
        System.out.println("PremiumBankAccount: Enhanced validation");
        if (amount <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Premium account: Amount must be positive");
        }
        // Additional premium validation
        if (amount > 10000) {
            System.out.println("Large transaction detected - additional security checks");
        }
    }
    
    // This method cannot call the parent's private validateTransaction
    public void premiumDeposit(double amount) {
        // validateTransaction(amount); // This calls OUR private method, not parent's
        balance += amount; // Direct access to inherited public field (BAD design)
        System.out.println("PremiumBankAccount: Premium deposit of $" + amount);
    }
}

// Demonstration of the confusion
public class ConfusingExample {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        PremiumBankAccount account = new PremiumBankAccount();
        
        // This calls BasicBankAccount.deposit() which calls BasicBankAccount.validateTransaction()
        account.deposit(100); // Output: "BasicBankAccount: Deposited $100"
        
        // This calls PremiumBankAccount.premiumDeposit() which calls PremiumBankAccount.validateTransaction()
        account.premiumDeposit(200); // Output: "Large transaction detected..." then "PremiumBankAccount: Premium deposit of $200"
        
        // The two validateTransaction methods are completely separate!
    }
}
```

**Problems with Basic Approach**:
- Public fields break encapsulation
- Private methods create confusion about inheritance
- No proper access control or security
- Mixed responsibilities and poor design

### Solution Approach 2: Optimal Implementation (Production-Ready)

**Java Implementation**:
```java
/**
 * COMPREHENSIVE BANKING SYSTEM: Demonstrates proper access control and encapsulation
 * Features: Secure transactions, audit logging, role-based access, proper encapsulation
 */

// Enums for type safety
public enum AccountType {
    BASIC(1000, 0.01, 3),
    PREMIUM(10000, 0.02, 10),
    BUSINESS(100000, 0.025, 50),
    PRIVATE_BANKING(1000000, 0.03, 100);
    
    private final double dailyLimit;
    private final double interestRate;
    private final int freeTransactionsPerMonth;
    
    AccountType(double dailyLimit, double interestRate, int freeTransactions) {
        this.dailyLimit = dailyLimit;
        this.interestRate = interestRate;
        this.freeTransactionsPerMonth = freeTransactions;
    }
    
    public double getDailyLimit() { return dailyLimit; }
    public double getInterestRate() { return interestRate; }
    public int getFreeTransactionsPerMonth() { return freeTransactionsPerMonth; }
}

public enum TransactionType {
    DEPOSIT, WITHDRAWAL, TRANSFER, INTEREST_PAYMENT, FEE_CHARGE
}

public enum UserRole {
    ACCOUNT_HOLDER(1),
    JOINT_HOLDER(2),
    AUTHORIZED_USER(3),
    BANK_EMPLOYEE(4),
    BANK_MANAGER(5),
    SYSTEM_ADMIN(6);
    
    private final int accessLevel;
    
    UserRole(int accessLevel) {
        this.accessLevel = accessLevel;
    }
    
    public int getAccessLevel() { return accessLevel; }
    
    public boolean canPerform(UserRole requiredRole) {
        return this.accessLevel >= requiredRole.accessLevel;
    }
}

/**
 * TRANSACTION RECORD: Immutable record for audit trail
 */
public class TransactionRecord {
    private final String transactionId;
    private final LocalDateTime timestamp;
    private final TransactionType type;
    private final double amount;
    private final double balanceAfter;
    private final String description;
    private final String initiatedBy;
    private final boolean successful;
    
    public TransactionRecord(String transactionId, TransactionType type, double amount, 
                           double balanceAfter, String description, String initiatedBy, boolean successful) {
        this.transactionId = transactionId;
        this.timestamp = LocalDateTime.now();
        this.type = type;
        this.amount = amount;
        this.balanceAfter = balanceAfter;
        this.description = description;
        this.initiatedBy = initiatedBy;
        this.successful = successful;
    }
    
    // Getters only (immutable)
    public String getTransactionId() { return transactionId; }
    public LocalDateTime getTimestamp() { return timestamp; }
    public TransactionType getType() { return type; }
    public double getAmount() { return amount; }
    public double getBalanceAfter() { return balanceAfter; }
    public String getDescription() { return description; }
    public String getInitiatedBy() { return initiatedBy; }
    public boolean isSuccessful() { return successful; }
    
    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return String.format("Transaction{id='%s', type=%s, amount=%.2f, balance=%.2f, time=%s, by='%s', success=%s}",
                           transactionId, type, amount, balanceAfter, timestamp, initiatedBy, successful);
    }
}

/**
 * SECURE BANK ACCOUNT: Base class with proper encapsulation
 * Demonstrates private methods that cannot be overridden
 */
public abstract class SecureBankAccount {
    // Private fields - proper encapsulation
    private final String accountNumber;
    private final String accountHolderName;
    private final AccountType accountType;
    private final LocalDateTime createdAt;
    
    // Protected fields - accessible to subclasses but not external classes
    protected volatile double balance; // volatile for thread safety
    protected final List<TransactionRecord> transactionHistory;
    protected final Map<String, UserRole> authorizedUsers;
    protected volatile boolean accountLocked;
    protected volatile int failedTransactionAttempts;
    
    // Private constants
    private static final int MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS = 3;
    private static final String TRANSACTION_ID_PREFIX = "TXN";
    private static final AtomicLong transactionCounter = new AtomicLong(1);
    
    protected SecureBankAccount(String accountNumber, String accountHolderName, AccountType accountType) {
        this.accountNumber = validateAccountNumber(accountNumber);
        this.accountHolderName = validateName(accountHolderName);
        this.accountType = Objects.requireNonNull(accountType, "Account type cannot be null");
        this.createdAt = LocalDateTime.now();
        this.balance = 0.0;
        this.transactionHistory = Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>());
        this.authorizedUsers = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        this.accountLocked = false;
        this.failedTransactionAttempts = 0;
        
        // Add account holder as primary user
        this.authorizedUsers.put(accountHolderName, UserRole.ACCOUNT_HOLDER);
    }
    
    // PRIVATE METHODS - Cannot be overridden, not inherited, implementation details
    
    /**
     * PRIVATE: Validates transaction amount and business rules
     * This method CANNOT be overridden by subclasses
     */
    private void validateTransactionAmount(double amount, TransactionType type) {
        if (amount <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Transaction amount must be positive");
        }
        
        if (Double.isNaN(amount) || Double.isInfinite(amount)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid transaction amount");
        }
        
        // Check daily limits
        double dailyTotal = calculateDailyTransactionTotal();
        if (dailyTotal + amount > accountType.getDailyLimit()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                String.format("Transaction would exceed daily limit of $%.2f (current: $%.2f)", 
                            accountType.getDailyLimit(), dailyTotal));
        }
        
        // Type-specific validation
        if (type == TransactionType.WITHDRAWAL && amount > balance) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Insufficient funds for withdrawal");
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * PRIVATE: Validates user authorization for transaction
     * This method CANNOT be overridden by subclasses
     */
    private void validateUserAuthorization(String userId, UserRole requiredRole) {
        if (userId == null || userId.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new SecurityException("User ID cannot be null or empty");
        }
        
        if (accountLocked) {
            throw new SecurityException("Account is locked due to security concerns");
        }
        
        UserRole userRole = authorizedUsers.get(userId);
        if (userRole == null) {
            recordFailedAttempt();
            throw new SecurityException("User not authorized for this account");
        }
        
        if (!userRole.canPerform(requiredRole)) {
            recordFailedAttempt();
            throw new SecurityException(
                String.format("User role %s insufficient for required role %s", userRole, requiredRole));
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * PRIVATE: Records transaction in audit log
     * This method CANNOT be overridden by subclasses
     */
    private TransactionRecord recordTransaction(TransactionType type, double amount, 
                                              String description, String initiatedBy, boolean successful) {
        String transactionId = generateTransactionId();
        TransactionRecord record = new TransactionRecord(
            transactionId, type, amount, balance, description, initiatedBy, successful
        );
        
        transactionHistory.add(record);
        
        // Log to external audit system (in real implementation)
        logToAuditSystem(record);
        
        return record;
    }
    
    /**
     * PRIVATE: Generates unique transaction ID
     * This method CANNOT be overridden by subclasses
     */
    private String generateTransactionId() {
        return TRANSACTION_ID_PREFIX + "-" + accountNumber + "-" + 
               String.format("%08d", transactionCounter.getAndIncrement());
    }
    
    /**
     * PRIVATE: Records failed transaction attempt for security
     * This method CANNOT be overridden by subclasses
     */
    private void recordFailedAttempt() {
        failedTransactionAttempts++;
        if (failedTransactionAttempts >= MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS) {
            accountLocked = true;
            System.err.println("SECURITY ALERT: Account " + accountNumber + " locked due to multiple failed attempts");
            // In real implementation, send alert to security team
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * PRIVATE: Logs transaction to external audit system
     * This method CANNOT be overridden by subclasses
     */
    private void logToAuditSystem(TransactionRecord record) {
        // In real implementation, this would log to external audit system
        System.out.println("AUDIT LOG: " + record);
    }
    
    // PROTECTED METHODS - Accessible to subclasses for extension
    
    /**
     * PROTECTED: Calculates daily transaction total (accessible to subclasses)
     */
    protected double calculateDailyTransactionTotal() {
        LocalDate today = LocalDate.now();
        return transactionHistory.stream()
            .filter(record -> record.getTimestamp().toLocalDate().equals(today))
            .filter(TransactionRecord::isSuccessful)
            .filter(record -> record.getType() == TransactionType.WITHDRAWAL || 
                            record.getType() == TransactionType.TRANSFER)
            .mapToDouble(TransactionRecord::getAmount)
            .sum();
    }
    
    /**
     * PROTECTED: Template method for transaction processing (can be extended by subclasses)
     */
    protected final TransactionRecord processTransaction(TransactionType type, double amount, 
                                                       String description, String userId) {
        try {
            // Step 1: Validate user authorization (uses private method)
            validateUserAuthorization(userId, UserRole.ACCOUNT_HOLDER);
            
            // Step 2: Validate transaction (uses private method)
            validateTransactionAmount(amount, type);
            
            // Step 3: Perform account-specific validation (hook for subclasses)
            performAccountSpecificValidation(type, amount, userId);
            
            // Step 4: Execute transaction
            executeTransaction(type, amount);
            
            // Step 5: Record successful transaction (uses private method)
            TransactionRecord record = recordTransaction(type, amount, description, userId, true);
            
            // Step 6: Reset failed attempts on successful transaction
            failedTransactionAttempts = 0;
            
            return record;
            
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // Record failed transaction (uses private method)
            recordTransaction(type, amount, description + " - FAILED: " + e.getMessage(), userId, false);
            throw e;
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * PROTECTED: Hook method for subclass-specific validation
     */
    protected abstract void performAccountSpecificValidation(TransactionType type, double amount, String userId);
    
    /**
     * PROTECTED: Executes the actual transaction
     */
    protected void executeTransaction(TransactionType type, double amount) {
        switch (type) {
            case DEPOSIT:
                balance += amount;
                break;
            case WITHDRAWAL:
                balance -= amount;
                break;
            case FEE_CHARGE:
                balance -= amount;
                break;
            case INTEREST_PAYMENT:
                balance += amount;
                break;
            default:
                throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Transaction type not supported: " + type);
        }
    }
    
    // PUBLIC METHODS - External interface
    
    /**
     * PUBLIC: Deposit money (uses private validation methods)
     */
    public final TransactionRecord deposit(double amount, String userId) {
        return processTransaction(TransactionType.DEPOSIT, amount, "Deposit", userId);
    }
    
    /**
     * PUBLIC: Withdraw money (uses private validation methods)
     */
    public final TransactionRecord withdraw(double amount, String userId) {
        return processTransaction(TransactionType.WITHDRAWAL, amount, "Withdrawal", userId);
    }
    
    /**
     * PUBLIC: Add authorized user (requires account holder privileges)
     */
    public final void addAuthorizedUser(String newUserId, UserRole role, String requestingUserId) {
        validateUserAuthorization(requestingUserId, UserRole.ACCOUNT_HOLDER);
        
        if (newUserId == null || newUserId.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("User ID cannot be null or empty");
        }
        
        authorizedUsers.put(newUserId, role);
        recordTransaction(TransactionType.DEPOSIT, 0, 
                        "Added authorized user: " + newUserId + " with role: " + role, 
                        requestingUserId, true);
    }
    
    // Validation methods
    private String validateAccountNumber(String accountNumber) {
        if (accountNumber == null || !accountNumber.matches("\\d{10,12}")) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Account number must be 10-12 digits");
        }
        return accountNumber;
    }
    
    private String validateName(String name) {
        if (name == null || name.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Account holder name cannot be null or empty");
        }
        return name.trim();
    }
    
    // Public getters (controlled access)
    public final String getAccountNumber() { return accountNumber; }
    public final String getAccountHolderName() { return accountHolderName; }
    public final AccountType getAccountType() { return accountType; }
    public final LocalDateTime getCreatedAt() { return createdAt; }
    public final double getBalance() { return balance; }
    public final boolean isAccountLocked() { return accountLocked; }
    
    public final List<TransactionRecord> getTransactionHistory(String userId) {
        validateUserAuthorization(userId, UserRole.AUTHORIZED_USER);
        return new ArrayList<>(transactionHistory);
    }
}

/**
 * BASIC BANK ACCOUNT: Concrete implementation with basic features
 */
public class BasicBankAccount extends SecureBankAccount {
    
    public BasicBankAccount(String accountNumber, String accountHolderName) {
        super(accountNumber, accountHolderName, AccountType.BASIC);
    }
    
    // This is NOT overriding any private method - private methods are not inherited!
    // This is a completely new private method specific to BasicBankAccount
    private void performBasicSecurityCheck(double amount) {
        if (amount > 500) {
            System.out.println("BasicBankAccount: Large transaction alert for amount: $" + amount);
        }
    }
    
    @Override
    protected void performAccountSpecificValidation(TransactionType type, double amount, String userId) {
        // Basic account specific validation
        if (type == TransactionType.WITHDRAWAL && amount > 500) {
            // Use our own private method (not inherited from parent)
            performBasicSecurityCheck(amount);
        }
        
        // Basic accounts have additional restrictions
        if (type == TransactionType.WITHDRAWAL && amount > 1000) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Basic accounts cannot withdraw more than $1000 per transaction");
        }
    }
}

/**
 * PREMIUM BANK ACCOUNT: Enhanced features with additional security
 */
public class PremiumBankAccount extends SecureBankAccount {
    private final String relationshipManager;
    private final double overdraftLimit;
    
    public PremiumBankAccount(String accountNumber, String accountHolderName, 
                            String relationshipManager, double overdraftLimit) {
        super(accountNumber, accountHolderName, AccountType.PREMIUM);
        this.relationshipManager = relationshipManager;
        this.overdraftLimit = overdraftLimit;
    }
    
    // This is NOT overriding any private method from parent!
    // This is a completely new private method specific to PremiumBankAccount
    private void performPremiumSecurityCheck(double amount, String userId) {
        if (amount > 10000) {
            System.out.println("PremiumBankAccount: High-value transaction requires additional verification");
            System.out.println("Relationship Manager: " + relationshipManager + " will be notified");
            
            // In real implementation, send notification to relationship manager
            notifyRelationshipManager(amount, userId);
        }
    }
    
    private void notifyRelationshipManager(double amount, String userId) {
        // In real implementation, send notification
        System.out.println("NOTIFICATION: RM " + relationshipManager + 
                         " - High value transaction $" + amount + " by " + userId);
    }
    
    @Override
    protected void performAccountSpecificValidation(TransactionType type, double amount, String userId) {
        // Premium account specific validation
        if (type == TransactionType.WITHDRAWAL) {
            // Use our own private method (not inherited from parent)
            performPremiumSecurityCheck(amount, userId);
            
            // Premium accounts allow overdraft
            if (amount > balance + overdraftLimit) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    String.format("Transaction exceeds available balance ($%.2f) plus overdraft limit ($%.2f)", 
                                balance, overdraftLimit));
            }
        }
    }
    
    @Override
    protected void executeTransaction(TransactionType type, double amount) {
        if (type == TransactionType.WITHDRAWAL && amount > balance) {
            // Handle overdraft for premium accounts
            double overdraftUsed = amount - balance;
            System.out.println("Using overdraft: $" + overdraftUsed);
            balance = -overdraftUsed;
        } else {
            super.executeTransaction(type, amount);
        }
    }
    
    // Premium-specific methods
    public double getOverdraftLimit() { return overdraftLimit; }
    public String getRelationshipManager() { return relationshipManager; }
    public double getAvailableCredit() { return balance + overdraftLimit; }
}

/**
 * BUSINESS BANK ACCOUNT: Corporate features with multi-user access
 */
public class BusinessBankAccount extends SecureBankAccount {
    private final String businessLicense;
    private final Set<String> signatories;
    private final boolean requiresDualApproval;
    
    public BusinessBankAccount(String accountNumber, String businessName, 
                             String businessLicense, boolean requiresDualApproval) {
        super(accountNumber, businessName, AccountType.BUSINESS);
        this.businessLicense = businessLicense;
        this.signatories = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();
        this.requiresDualApproval = requiresDualApproval;
    }
    
    // This is NOT overriding any private method from parent!
    // This is a completely new private method specific to BusinessBankAccount
    private void validateBusinessTransaction(double amount, String userId) {
        if (!signatories.contains(userId)) {
            throw new SecurityException("User is not an authorized signatory");
        }
        
        if (requiresDualApproval && amount > 5000) {
            // In real implementation, this would require a second approval
            System.out.println("BusinessBankAccount: Large transaction requires dual approval");
        }
    }
    
    @Override
    protected void performAccountSpecificValidation(TransactionType type, double amount, String userId) {
        // Business account specific validation
        validateBusinessTransaction(amount, userId);
        
        // Business accounts have higher limits but more controls
        if (type == TransactionType.WITHDRAWAL && amount > 50000) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Single transaction limit exceeded ($50,000)");
        }
    }
    
    // Business-specific methods
    public void addSignatory(String userId, String requestingUserId) {
        validateUserAuthorization(requestingUserId, UserRole.ACCOUNT_HOLDER);
        signatories.add(userId);
        addAuthorizedUser(userId, UserRole.AUTHORIZED_USER, requestingUserId);
    }
    
    public Set<String> getSignatories() { return new HashSet<>(signatories); }
    public String getBusinessLicense() { return businessLicense; }
    public boolean requiresDualApproval() { return requiresDualApproval; }
}
```
